metric_rationale: This metric calculates the proportion of choices that align with the Take The Best (TTB) prediction specifically on trials where TTB and Tallying make strictly opposing predictions. Under the TTB theory, subjects will consistently choose the option favored by the first discriminating cue, yielding a high proportion. Under the Tallying theory, subjects will choose the option with more total feature wins, which is the exact opposite on these critical trials, yielding a very low proportion.

This metric isolates trials where Tallying and Take The Best (TTB) make opposite deterministic predictions. It computes the proportion of choices on these 'disagreement' trials that align with the Tallying heuristic. For data generated by Tallying, this proportion will be close to 1. For data generated by TTB, it will be close to 0. By restricting the calculation to trials with strict disagreement, it maximizes the quantitative contrast between the two theories and eliminates noise from agreement or guessing trials.
